title: antennaria media subsp. compacta
intro: Antennaria media subsp. compacta, commonly known as Mountain Silvermoss, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include its potential to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Antennaria media subsp. compacta are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
